frontier.observed: Canonical recovery can raise RecoveryIntegrityError when the causal/state spine cannot be trusted, while the outer recovery contract requires replacement of the entire admitted appliance boundary for Tier-2. Before this delta the service exposed only a generic process failure and no typed machine-readable bridge from canonical integrity failure to an external full-appliance replacer.
frontier.hypothesis: A reserved fail-closed exit code plus a bounded typed diagnostic gives deployment infrastructure an unambiguous Tier-2 trigger without creating a second state/recovery authority.
frontier.counterhypothesis: A generic non-zero container exit is sufficient for Tier-2 orchestration.
frontier.cheapest_discriminator: Execute the exact signal builder and exact service recovery-integrity path, then require the final Vercel Firecracker controller or a Kubernetes/Kata deployment controller to observe exit 86 and replace the complete admitted appliance boundary.

primary_upstream_basis: Kubernetes official documentation states that terminationMessagePath defaults to /dev/termination-log, File populates the terminated container status message from that file, and terminated container state exposes the exit code. The ClayVerse-specific meaning of exit 86 is repository policy, not a Kubernetes-reserved semantic. For the final Vercel Firecracker test-of-tests the external controller may rely on exit 86 even when Kubernetes termination-message semantics are absent.

evidence_boundary: The exact-file executions support the Tier-2 signal construction and service dispatch mechanism only. They do not prove outer-controller observation of exit 86, full Vercel Sandbox or Pod/Kata sandbox destruction, same OCI digest recreation, persistent-state recovery, generation fencing, secret reacquisition, Mistral cognition or no-replay behavior on a real admitted target.
promotion_gate: Fuse current compatible deployment lanes, then in the owner-mandated Vercel Firecracker test-of-tests force a real RecoveryIntegrityError in the exact ClayVerse OCI, observe container exit 86, prove the outer controller destroys/recreates the complete Sandbox/appliance rather than restarting the inner container, rerun the SAME accepted image digest, recover declared persistent state under a new global generation, reacquire the Mistral secret from the approved Vault boundary, reject stale results and prove ambiguous external effects are not replayed. For Kubernetes/Kata deployments additionally observe clayverse.tier2-fatal/v1 when available and prove new Pod UID plus new Kata sandbox/VM identity.
execution_frontier: The old token-routing prohibition is no longer the blocker. The next retained Vercel run requires an actually available scoped read-only GITHUB_READ_TOKEN to be securely injected or otherwise used for exact private-source acquisition, followed by exact source identity verification and the owner-mandated Firecracker + Docker/OCI + Vault Mistral end-to-end sequence. Token availability/injection has not yet been observed in this go.
